import unittest

from rosterkit.notices import build_notice
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from datetime import date

PUPIL = Student("s1", "Doe", "Jane", "A")

def mark(num, status="absent", owner="s1"):
    return Mark(owner, date(2026, 9, num), status)

class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_orders_dates_and_counts(self):
        marks = [mark(9), mark(2), mark(5, "present")]
        text = build_notice(PUPIL, marks)
        want = "Jane Doe missed 2 day(s): "
        want += "2026-09-02, 2026-09-09."
        self.assertEqual(text, want)

    def test_foreign_mark(self):
        marks = [mark(2), mark(3, owner="s2")]
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            build_notice(PUPIL, marks)

    def test_no_absences(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            build_notice(PUPIL, [mark(2, "late")])
